subject: MR-0003;MR-0007
decision: EU03 and EU07 are kept as two resources. The shared URL is recorded as the description page of MR-0003 and as the page of MR-0007; the access address of MR-0003 is recorded separately.
rationale: The ELDS page describes the dump in its own section and gives it a different address. Re-captured on 2026-10-10: same SHA-256 as the G1-READY capture. A data.europa.eu catalogue entry for the dump exists as well. The duplicate hypothesis based on the URL alone is not re-applied.

subject: MR-0003
decision: HTTP 401 at datadump.publications.europa.eu is recorded as "authentication required", not as absence. No account was created and no login attempted.
rationale: Third 401 over two phases; the response carries no WWW-Authenticate header, so the scheme is unknown. Three official pages state that an EU Login account is needed.

subject: MR-0003
decision: Both official descriptions of the dump are recorded; neither is preferred.
rationale: ELDS page and EUR-Lex reuse page: acts in force, CELEX sector 3. data.europa.eu entry (issued 2025-05-08): sectors 2, 3 and 4. Only access to the dump can settle it.

subject: MR-0001
decision: Three catalogue entries (EU legislation currently in force; EU legislation - basic acts; EU legislative procedures) are recorded as catalogue endpoints of EUR-Lex, not as resources.
rationale: Their distributions are HTML links to EUR-Lex search forms and directories (catalogue API metadata). Counting them would inflate the inventory with views of one resource.

subject: MR-0004
decision: Twenty annual "Official Journals of the European Union" entries and the deprecated per-language entries are one resource with many distributions.
rationale: Same maintainer, same content type, partitioned by year or language.

subject: MR-0015;MR-0016;MR-0017;MR-0011;MR-0023
decision: Catalogue entries found for existing seeds (comitology-register, sg-regexp, transparency-register, council-votes-on-legislative-acts, european-case-law-identifier-ecli) are endpoints of those seeds.
rationale: A catalogue record describes a resource; it is not a second resource.

subject: MR-0044;MR-0054
decision: Two group placeholders are kept with status GROUP_PENDING_SPLIT and excluded from the count of individuated resources.
rationale: Five national ELI entries and seven Swedac entries were found but not read; splitting or merging them without reading would be guesswork.

subject: SEARCH_HITS
decision: Software without data of its own is not recorded as a resource: eurlex-builder (Zenodo 22807281 and GitHub tseidl/eurlex-builder), eulex-build, eurlex-toolbox, bulletin-fetcher (Zenodo 21393281), oeil_scraper (Zenodo 3403915).
rationale: They are tools to obtain data from official sources. Kept in search_hits.csv. Two exceptions are recorded as pointers with category SOFTWARE_OR_PIPELINE (MR-0081, MR-0097) because a dataset may be attached.

subject: SEARCH_HITS
decision: User re-uploads and task-specific reformattings on Hugging Face (for example the eurlexsum_* and multi_eurlex_* variants, the Europarl subsets, the JRC-Acquis sub-corpora, the GDPR classification sets) are not recorded as resources.
rationale: They are copies or preprocessed subsets of datasets already in the base or of unknown origin. Recording each would multiply distributions into resources.

subject: SEARCH_HITS
decision: Hits that are publications without a dataset (articles, reports, deliverables, opinion pieces) were not recorded, except data papers whose title announces a dataset.
rationale: The object of the mapping is data resources. Screening was done on titles and, where available, on the API description, by the agent alone: provisional.

subject: SEARCH_HITS
decision: Single-policy thematic compilations were left unrecorded for now: the CRCF Regulation data set (Zenodo 15012191), the AI/TDM/copyright legal sources dataset (Zenodo 20805193), the list of acts on food loss (10.34810/data2872), the FORSEE corpus of AI documents, the "European Commission Dataset" on emigration (Zenodo 14290522).
rationale: Whether narrow thematic compilations belong in the inventory is a scope decision for the researcher. They remain in search_hits.csv.

subject: SEARCH_HITS
decision: National and local records returned by data.europa.eu with no stated link to EU law (for example municipal registers, national court lists, Ukrainian court-decision registers, UK planning consultations) were not recorded.
rationale: Outside the geographic rule: national resources enter only with a documented connection to EU legislation, implementation or governance.

subject: MR-0033;MR-0034;MR-0040;MR-0060;MR-0065;MR-0068;MR-0093
decision: Eligibility recorded as UNCERTAIN rather than decided.
rationale: Procurement notices, European Council conclusions, parliamentary debates, single-instrument national case-law and a dataset on national parliaments sit at the edge of sets A and B. The rule is the researcher's to set.

subject: ALL
decision: Two categories were added to the twelve named in the G2 instruction: STANDARD_OR_VOCABULARY and SOFTWARE_OR_PIPELINE; INDETERMINATE is used when the evidence does not allow a proposal.
rationale: ELI, ECLI and the CDM ontology are none of the twelve; forcing them into "dataset" or "infrastructure" would misdescribe them.

subject: SR-G2-004;SR-G2-009;SR-G2-012;SR-G2-014;SR-G2-017;SR-G2-020;SR-G2-021;SR-G2-022;SR-G2-024
decision: Nine data.europa.eu queries produced no record linked to a resource: CELLAR, delegated acts, infringement, trusted flaggers, competent authorities, accreditation, register of authorised, public consultation feedback, and the German-language query on notified bodies (which only repeated hits of SR-G2-013).
rationale: The catalogue search is free text over all European catalogues and ranks national and local records first. Absence from the first 25 hits does not show that no such dataset is catalogued, and says nothing about resources published outside the catalogue (several of them are seeds verified on their own sites).

subject: SR-G2-032;SR-G2-037;SR-G2-038;SR-G2-042;SR-G2-043
decision: Five academic queries produced no record linked to a resource (Zenodo "GDPR enforcement decisions dataset"; DataCite "eur-lex"; DataCite "European Union regulatory governance"; OpenAlex compliance and agency queries).
rationale: OpenAlex returned articles about compliance and agencies, some of which rest on datasets that are not announced in the title. Reading those articles is a task for the next round.

subject: MR-0003;MR-0007
decision: EU03 and EU07 stay distinct after a second, independent capture of the ELDS page and a third request to the dump address.
rationale: The ELDS page was captured again in round 2 (same SHA-256 as in G1-READY). The catalogue entry "eur-lex-data-dump" (publisher: Publications Office) is a third description of the dump. The dump address answered HTTP 401 again; no authentication was attempted.

subject: ALL
decision: Amendment A01 separates Level I (data) from Level II (infrastructure) and reports the two counts separately; no row is removed or reclassified retrospectively.
rationale: See mapping/protocol/AMENDMENT_A01_DATA_VS_INFRASTRUCTURE_v1_0.md. The levels are derived from the existing category column.

subject: CATALOGUE_FAMILIES
decision: A catalogue family (records that differ only by instance label such as bank, year, language or country-neutral series) is one resource; records whose title declares them a module of a named system are counted with their parent.
rationale: Applied to EBA stress tests and transparency exercises, ERADIS modules, EUIPO series, EFCA deployment plans, EMA medicine data, JRC vehicle datasets, the Swedac lists and others. The unit therefore follows each maintainer's own catalogue granularity, which differs between maintainers.

subject: EU_CATALOGUES
decision: In the EU institutional catalogues, entries were individuated when they are registers or databases of regulated entities, authorisations, decisions, sanctions or enforcement, or lists with legal effect. Market-data systems, statistics series, reports and documents were not individuated, with exceptions flagged UNCERTAIN.
rationale: Applies to ESMA (FIRDS, FITRS, prospectuses, position reporting, net short positions not individuated), EIOPA statistics, ECDC, Frontex, Europol, FRA, EASO, LISA, OSHA and ECA (not recorded).

subject: DEU_FREE_TEXT
decision: The twenty-three thematic free-text queries across all data.europa.eu catalogues (SR-G2-119 to SR-G2-141) produced records of national and local bodies almost exclusively and no EU-level register that the catalogue enumeration had not already found, except the JRC market-surveillance datasets.
rationale: Free text over the whole catalogue is dominated by national and local portals; enumerating the EU institutional catalogues was the productive route.

subject: SW_FAILED
decision: Fourteen institutional sweep requests failed (404, 403 or certificate verification errors on three hosts). They are access failures of addresses proposed by the agent or blocked to the client, not evidence that those bodies publish no register.
rationale: SW-003, SW-004, SW-019, SW-021, SW-025, SW-026, SW-027, SW-028, SW-031, SW-032, SW-034, SW-038, SW-040 and SW-047 (the last is a second attempt for a round-1 failure).

subject: SW_NETWORKS
decision: Pages describing networks and bodies (ECN, CPC network, EDPB members, European Accreditation, EPPO, ELA, EASA publications, ECA publications, CJEU reports) were read and not individuated: they describe organisations, not data resources.
rationale: No downloadable list or register was identified on those pages in this round.

subject: EU_AGENCY_LIST
decision: The two official list pages of EU bodies (SW-001, SW-002) could not be used as a complete list: they are paginated or dynamic and only the first entries were readable. The data.europa.eu catalogue enumeration (212 catalogues, 124 labelled with the country EUROPE, which include EU institutions and agencies and some projects) was used as the working list.
rationale: Coverage of EU bodies is therefore measured against the catalogue, not against an official register of bodies.

subject: MR-0003
decision: The description conflict on the dump scope (CELEX sector 3 versus sectors 2, 3 and 4) is unchanged; the access address registered by the catalogue entry (/dashboard) differs from the one on the ELDS page (root).
rationale: Both addresses require the EU Login account according to the catalogue text; neither was authenticated.

subject: MR-0092;MR-0058;MR-0088
decision: Three Hugging Face datasets that describe themselves as derived from EUR-Lex or Cellar are recorded as derived resources with their stated source.
rationale: The statements come from the dataset cards (API metadata). They show derivation claimed by the depositors, not verified lineage.

subject: EFSA;ECDC;FRONTEX;ECA
decision: Scientific, surveillance and report series from EFSA (except two UNCERTAIN databases), ECDC, Frontex and ECA are not individuated.
rationale: They are not registers or decisions under a regulatory regime; the scope rule for such series remains an open decision (D1).

subject: ROUND2_FETCH
decision: Eleven Zenodo record requests failed in the first fetch pass because the address builder put the DOI into the record address (an agent defect); they were corrected and requested again. Seven DOI requests went first to DataCite, answered 404 because those DOIs are registered at Crossref, and were repeated there. All failed requests stay in the capture log.
rationale: The first-pass failures (HTTP 404) are defects or routing choices of the agent's tool, not facts about the resources.
